# wayscloud_database_types (Data Source)

Fetches the list of available WAYSCloud database types and tiers.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "wayscloud_database_types" "all" {}

output "available_types" {
  value = data.wayscloud_database_types.all.database_types
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `database_types` (Attributes List) List of available database types. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--database_types))

<a id="nestedatt--database_types"></a>
### Nested Schema for `database_types`

Read-Only:

- `description` (String) Human-readable description of the database tier.
- `is_encrypted` (Boolean) Whether this tier uses encryption at rest.
- `name` (String) Display name of the database tier.
- `tier` (String) Tier level (e.g., `standard`, `encrypted`).
